messages:
maria (Sales Ops): Acme procurement just returned the POC orderform. Two hard asks: their AP requires the PO PDF embedded inside the signed DocuSign envelope, and QA added an HSM requirement in the DPA appendix. Need advice on both.

tom (AE): Oof. Do they mean FIPS HSM or just 'customer-managed keys'? Can you paste the exact DPA wording?

maria (Sales Ops): Quote from them: 'All cryptographic keys used to protect data at rest for the service must be backed by FIPS 140-2 validated HSM or equivalent.' They also added a field on the PO: "Invoice Processing Code (internal)" that must appear on our invoice.

lee (SE): For the PO-in-envelope: DocuSign supports adding the PO as an envelope document. Two caveats: 1) document order matters for some AP systems, 2) if we use our template with composite templates, attachments can be lost unless we explicitly add documents array.

docu-sign-bot: Tip: include the customer's PO as a separate document in the envelope (documents[].name = "Customer_PO.pdf"). Set documentId so it appears before the orderform if required. Use 'documentVisibility' and recipientId to control who sees which docs.

nora (Legal): On HSM language: we can't promise HSM backing on hosted tier for each tenant. We can offer: (a) Private deployment with customer-managed HSM/KMS; (b) Hosted: we can support customer-supplied keys via cloud KMS integrations but not per-customer dedicated HSM slots. Recommend we propose an appendix: "Key Management options: Hosted KMS integration OR Private HSM-backed deployment (subject to separate SOW)."

jake (Finance): Regarding that 'Invoice Processing Code' — we need them to confirm whether that code goes into the invoice 'description' field or the invoice 'memo' so our accounting system maps it. Also confirm payment terms: their PO shows 'Net TBD'. Can't invoice until we have payment terms and tax ID.

tom (AE): Action items: 1) Maria to ask Acme to confirm doc order (PO first?) and exact field mapping for processing code; 2) Nora to prepare short DPA appendix clarifying Hosted vs Private KMS/HSM; 3) Lee to draft a DocuSign envelope example for eng that preserves added documents.

lee (SE): Example payload (REST):

```
POST /v2.1/accounts/{accountId}/envelopes
{
  "emailSubject": "Acme POC Orderform",
  "documents": [
    { "documentBase64": "<base64 of Acme_PO.pdf>", "name": "Acme_PO.pdf", "documentId": "1" },
    { "documentBase64": "<base64 of Orderform.pdf>", "name": "Orderform.pdf", "documentId": "2" }
  ],
  "recipients": { "signers": [ { "email": "buyer@acme.com", "name": "Acme Buyer", "recipientId": "1" }, { "email": "tom@redwood.com", "name": "Tom (Redwood)", "recipientId": "2" } ] },
  "status": "sent"
}
```

lee (SE): Note the document order: PO docId=1 makes it appear first. Add 'documentVisibility' if some internal docs should be hidden from customer (but likely not in this case).

docu-sign-bot: Reminder: signerAttachment tabs are a different feature; they collect uploaded files during signing. Since the customer already has a PO PDF, include it as a document not a signerAttachment. Templates + compositeTemplates require explicit documentRefs.

nora (Legal): Draft language suggestion for order acceptance: "A Purchase Order that references the MSA and the Orderform and is signed by Customer and countersigned or electronically accepted by Redwood constitutes a binding order." Also will include a sentence that any HSM requirement for hosted service is subject to separate procurement for Private deployment.

jake (Finance): If we accept PO-as-acceptance we still need an electronic audit trail. Prefer countersignature in DocuSign so AP can see both sides signed. Also we need Acme's remit address and tax ID on the PO.

maria (Sales Ops): I'll ask Acme to: - Confirm document ordering (PO first) - Provide remit address, tax ID, invoice processing code, payment terms - Confirm whether exec signature needed if POC > $40k

tom (AE): If Acme insists on HSM for hosted, push for Private deployment or SOW for dedicated HSM. Don't accept a flat HSM warranty for hosted.

nora (Legal): Agreed. I'll mark the DPA appendix as negotiable and add a checkbox: "Customer requires HSM-backed key storage: [ ] Yes [ ] No — if Yes, parties agree to engage on Private Deployment SOW."

maria (Sales Ops): I'll collect the fields and reply with Acme's answers. If they confirm PO-first, I'll prepare the envelope and request sign order: Customer -> Tom -> Nora (only if >40k).

lee (SE): I'll put together a quick unit test harness to produce an envelope and return the completed envelope combined PDF so we can verify the PO shows up at the top. Will share link to test result.

jake (Finance): One more thing: confirm whether Acme wants invoices sent to AP@acme or to a third-party billing portal.

tom (AE): Good thread. Maria, keep us looped. Nora, ping when redline ready. Lee, post test link when done.

maria (Sales Ops): Will do — thanks everyone.
